About Juniper Lane Health
Juniper Lane Health is a fictional, fast-growing digital clinic network serving 40 communities. We believe everyone deserves care that is simple, kind and on time. Our team of 300 people works hybrid across three regional hubs.

The role
We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with our clinic partners after launch. You will be the main point of contact for a portfolio of 25 to 40 partner clinics and help them get measurable value from our scheduling platform.

What you'll do
- Own onboarding for new clinic partners and lead kickoff and training sessions
- Build trusted relationships with clinic managers and senior stakeholders
- Monitor account health using product usage data and act early on churn risk
- Run quarterly business reviews that show outcomes and agree next steps
- Turn customer feedback into clear, prioritised requests for the product team
- Resolve escalations calmly and follow through until the issue is closed

What you'll bring
- 3+ years in customer success, account management or a similar client-facing role
- Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior audiences
- Confidence working with data: you can build a simple report in Excel or Google Sheets and explain what it means
- Experience with a CRM such as Salesforce or HubSpot
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A track record of improving retention or renewal rates

Nice to have
- Experience in healthcare, SaaS or scheduling software
- Familiarity with SQL or a BI tool such as Looker
- A second language

What we offer
- Hybrid work, 3 days in a hub
- Learning budget and mentoring
- Extended health benefits
